extraction_notes: Angle Health level-funded quote proposals. Structure: Page 1 cover with group name, effective date, quote ID. Page 2 'Quote Details' has funding type, contract terms, minimum enrollment, agency, subscriber/member counts, network (Cigna) & PBM (Cerpass AngleRx), add-ons chosen, then a master 'Rates' table listing ALL plans in one grid with columns Employee Only / Employee+Spouse / Employee+Children / Employee+Family / Actuarial Value (a 'Subscribers in tier' row shows census counts, not a plan). This document had 19 plans total (14 on page2, 5 continued on page3 - watch for continuation page labeled 'RATES (CONTINUED)'). Then individual 'PLANS' pages follow (pages 4-22 here), one per plan, each with: plan name as H1, Plan ID, Quote ID; 'In-Network Deductibles' box with 4 values (Deductible Individual, Deductible Family, OOPM Individual, OOPM Family); a Services table with columns Services/Cost Share/Deductible Applies - consistently ~19 rows (Primary Care (Office), Specialist (Office), Virtual Care, Preventive Care, Urgent Care, Emergency Room, Inpatient Facility, Diagnostic Tests (X-Ray), Outpatient Facility, Outpatient Professional, Speech Therapy - OP Prof., Physical/Occupational Therapy - OP Prof., Independent Laboratory, Imaging - OP Facility, All Other Covered Services, Tier 1-4 Rx, International Rx Sourcing); then 'Out of Network Deductibles' box (Deductible Individual OON, OOPM Individual OON, Deductible Family OON, OOPM Family OON, Coinsurance OON, Deductible Embedded Yes/No); then 'Rates' box repeating the 4 premium tiers (no 'family' separate from 'employee+family' - only 4 tiers total, no true family tier distinct). Plan naming convention: 'ANG HDHP/TRAD/VALUE ####  ####' where numbers are deductible/OOPM or similar - do not assume meaning, just use as plan name. Every plan in the summary rate grid should have a matching detail page - confirm count matches (this doc: 19 plans, 19 detail pages). After plans, additional 'FUNDING ALLOCATION' pages break down each plan's premium into Claims Fund, Stoploss Premium, and Administrative Fee by tier - these are supplementary illustrative breakdowns of the same rates, not separate plans, so do not record as new plans. Then a 'CENSUS QUOTED IN PROPOSAL' section lists individual members (not benefit data). Final pages are marketing/cost-of-ownership collateral - ignore for extraction. No 'employee_children' vs 'family' distinction beyond the 4 standard tiers - map 'Employee + Family' to 'family' key and 'Employee + Child(ren)' to 'employee_children'.
